name: deckcp-deck-making-skills
title: DeckCP deck-making skill pack
description: Interview, outline, critique, brand, build, quality-check, edit, analyze, and share great decks from Claude Code. Two tiers: provider-agnostic deck craft that works with no DeckCP account, plus DeckCP-powered skills that drive the DeckCP MCP. Every deck is built on a real design system and gated by a quality check before it is called done.
principles: Scripts over tokens — deterministic bash/node does the heavy lifting for free (dedup, hashing, consistency scans, formatting).

Three model tiers, chosen per step and justified in each SKILL.md: (1) pure script wherever deterministic; (2) Haiku 4.5 subagent only for cheap mechanical classification (asset captioning, fuzzy terminology matching); (3) the user's main-loop model for real-judgment steps (interview, outline, critique, multi-lens analysis) — NOT downgraded, because the Tier-1 craft skills are the self-marketing surface.
Tier 1 is deliberately useful with no DeckCP account, so it self-markets DeckCP to people who then convert.

Every deck is built on a real design system (deckcp-brand-kit: extract the brand literally, or synthesize to the deckcp.com/templates standard) and nothing is done until it passes deckcp-quality-control (render every slide, score brand/alignment/spacing/polish/repetition/generic-AI, fix, re-score).

tiers.1: Provider-agnostic deck craft — no DeckCP account required.

skills.name: deckcp-onboard
skills.summary: Start here — verify the MCP connection (degrade gracefully to Tier 1 without one), orient on decks/brand, ask one intent question, route to exactly one next skill.

skills.name: deckcp-author-slides
skills.summary: Manual slide authoring against the rendering contract: classes-only vocabulary, typed chart props vs pipe-string primitives, frontmatter shape, presets, masters, and the check_slide → upsert → render-and-look loop.

skills.name: deck-interview
skills.summary: Interrogate a founder/salesperson/BD: audience, goal, the ask, proof, narrative. Willing to push back on weak positioning. Emits brief.json.

skills.name: deck-outline
skills.summary: Outline-first: turn the brief into a story spine (problem→insight→solution→proof→ask) before any slides. Emits outline.json + outline.md.

skills.name: deck-critique
skills.summary: Pressure-test the story: headline-only read, the skeptic, the 5-second test, proof audit (evidence vs hope), the ask, audience + setting fit. Seven prioritized findings max (blocker/weak/polish) with the fix and the skill that makes it. scripts/spine.js prints the headline spine from outline.json / a saved get_deck / markdown.

skills.name: deck-analyze-consistency
skills.summary: Script-first check of fonts/colors/spacing/terminology consistency across slides. Zero tokens for the scan; Haiku only for fuzzy terminology grouping. ABSORBED into deckcp-quality-control (scripts/scan-deck.js does the colour/size/spacing/repetition scan).

skills.name: deck-analyze-visual
skills.summary: Render each slide and look at it — balance, hierarchy, contrast, density, the 5-second test. ABSORBED into deckcp-quality-control (render every slide, score six dimensions).

skills.name: deck-analyze-multi
skills.summary: Run several lenses (investor, sales, skeptic, 5-second test) and synthesize a prioritized fix list.

skills.name: deck-writing-samples
skills.summary: Distill the user's voice/tone from writing samples into voice.json that later steps feed to copy.

skills.name: github-lookup
skills.summary: Resolve a person from GitHub by username, commit SHA, or email — name, profile, and public/commit-author email. Pairs with deckcp-email. Uses the gh CLI.

skills.name: deckcp-gather-assets
skills.summary: Search the user's drive for images/videos, dedupe by hash, copy into ./deck-assets/, batch-upload via the MCP. Pure script.

skills.name: deckcp-brand-kit
skills.summary: The design system a deck is built on. EXTRACT (script-first, scripts/extract-brand.js) captures the WHOLE system — not just colour/type but imagery treatment, layout style, graphic elements, and the repeating per-slide chrome (eyebrow + headline + footer), rendering an existing deck/guide to images and matching what it sees: literal hex from SVG fills/strokes, :root CSS vars + fonts + logo from a website, dk1/lt1/accent slots + typefaces from a PPTX theme, transcribed brand-guide lines — every token cited, never shifted. SYNTHESIZE (main-loop): one surface pair, one accent, one type pairing, one signature device, one structural language, benchmarked on deckcp.com/templates. scripts/check-kit.js validates hex, WCAG contrast, and the curated font catalog, then emits the update_deck.deck_theme payload. Writes theme (deck scope), logos (upload_asset), house style (set_masters scope brand, owned brands only, confirmed). Supersedes the planned deckcp-brand.

skills.name: deckcp-build-deck
skills.summary: brief/outline → deckcp-brand-kit (mandatory before generating) → generate_outline → generate_slides_from_outline → check_slide → render_slides → deckcp-quality-control (mandatory gate before "done"). Orchestration, minimal tokens. Reads references/layout-archetypes.md for template-grade layout variety + the chrome-as-master pattern.

skills.name: deckcp-quality-control
skills.summary: The mandatory final gate. scripts/scan-deck.js (zero tokens) flags off-palette hexes and colour classes, rainbow Card accents, sub-22px text, spacing-token sprawl, repeated layout skeletons, icon-card grids, dark-gradient defaults, buzzwords, label titles; check_slide on every slide; then render_slides format image on EVERY slide and score six dimensions 1-5 (brand accuracy — now incl. chrome consistency across slides, alignment, spacing consistency, visual polish — now incl. imagery coverage, repetitive layouts, generic-AI look). Pass = all ≥4. Fix loop maps each failure to the cheapest tool (deck_theme, masters, upsert class swap, rewrite_slide), max three passes, re-render everything, qc-report.md.

skills.name: deckcp-read-deck
skills.summary: Read and understand an existing deck — structure via get_deck, pixels via render_slides, then the story from the headlines. The reconnaissance step before any edit/critique/share.

skills.name: deckcp-edit
skills.summary: Deterministic edit recipes: theme (colors/fonts/margins) via update_deck.deck_theme, reorder/duplicate/delete, mechanical MDX edits via upsert_slides at the same slide_order; rewrite_slide only when copy must change. Always check_slide + render after.

skills.name: deckcp-analyze
skills.summary: get_deck_analytics → read the per-slide dwell curve like an editor (drop-off = weakest slide), then list_leads/get_lead to pick who to follow up with. Routes to deckcp-email and deckcp-edit.

skills.name: deckcp-share
skills.summary: Two-layer access model: per-person grants (share_deck/revoke_deck_access, roles) + the deck-wide gate (set_deck_share_mode: private/public/email/password, allow_remix). Confirms before widening access.

skills.name: deckcp-capture
skills.summary: Capture a person into the CRM from anything — conversation, card/badge photo, voice memo, GitHub, signature — via create_contact (email optional, upsert-by-email). The note carries the context; routes to share/email.

skills.name: deckcp-voice-memos
skills.summary: Semantic search over voice-memo transcripts (search_voice_memos) → deck material for deck-interview, contacts for deckcp-capture, or recalled facts. Excerpts first, full transcripts only for winners; privacy guardrails.

skills.name: deckcp-email
skills.summary: Email a contact (a DeckCP lead or anyone) via the Zavu messaging API — cc, reply-to, dry-run preview by default. Compose is main-loop; the send is a deterministic script. Needs ZAVU_API_KEY.

skills.name: deckcp-install
skills.summary: Meta skill: fetch the pack from the public repo into the user's .claude/skills via the MCP install tool's fetch-and-write instructions.
